raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: ldas-tools-diskcacheAPI-swig
  version: "2.6.16"
  ldas_tools_cmake_version: 1.5.0
  ldas_tools_diskcacheapi_version: 2.7.11
  ldas_tools_ldasgen_version: 2.7.7
  ldas_tools_ldasgen_swig_version: 2.6.14

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: http://software.ligo.org/lscsoft/source/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 019d0bb5fa7f7beda30d3657b6d638281df75d3042d8277c087b6a881382b91e

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ldas-tools-diskcacheapi-swig
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake >=3.12,<4.0.0a0
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - swig >=3.0.7
      host:
        - ldas-tools-cmake >=${{ ldas_tools_cmake_version }}
        - ldas-tools-ldasgen >=${{ ldas_tools_ldasgen_version }}
        - ldas-tools-diskcacheapi >=${{ ldas_tools_diskcacheapi_version }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - diskcacheAPI/diskCache.i

  - package:
      name: python-ldas-tools-diskcacheapi
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      script: build-python
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake >=3.12,<4.0.0a0
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - swig >=3.0.7
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('ldas-tools-diskcacheapi-swig', exact=True) }}
        - ldas-tools-cmake >=${{ ldas_tools_cmake_version }}
        - python
      run:
        - python
        - python-ldas-tools-al
        - python-ldas-tools-ldasgen >=${{ ldas_tools_ldasgen_swig_version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - LDAStools.diskCache
    about:
      summary: Python bindings for the LDAS Tools disk cache library

about:
  summary: SWIG interface for the LDAS Tools disk cache library
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/LDASTools
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/ldastools/LDAS_Tools.git
  documentation: https://computing.docs.ligo.org/ldastools/LDAS_Tools/ldas-tools-diskcacheAPI/
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - emaros
